literal: Suffering, suffering, let the inner water dry up, having desired, having melted, having wanted, the eyes that saw him.
translation: My eyes eagerly desired, melted, and begged to see him; now let them suffer and weep until their tears run dry.
modern: அவரைப் பார்க்க வேண்டும் என்று விரும்பி, மனம் உருகி, வேண்டி நின்ற என் கண்கள், இப்போது அவரைப் பிரிந்து அழுது அழுது தமக்குள்ளே இருக்கும் கண்ணீர் வற்றும் அளவுக்குத் துன்பப்படட்டும்.
explanation: The heroine addresses her own eyes, which are now weeping constantly because her lover is away. She reminds them that it was they who eagerly desired, melted, and begged to see him in the first place. Therefore, she says, let them now suffer the consequences of their own actions and weep until their tears completely dry up. The repetition of 'உழந்து' (suffering) emphasizes the intensity of the pain, while the sequence of 'விழைந்து இழைந்து வேண்டி' captures the escalating eagerness of the eyes before they saw him.
